errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart. The vertical axis contains the categories (reasons), while the horizontal axis represents the percentage values.
The categories on the vertical axis are not arranged in alphabetical order. The order appears to be arbitrary.
The horizontal axis is not labeled with all whole numbers; it is labeled at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60).
